# Provenance: testdata/v3/tx-anchored/

Offline fixtures for transaction-anchored criteria resolution tests
(`frontend/test/criteriaResolve.test.mjs`). Generated by an uncommitted
script using the repo's own criteria code, so every hash is consistent
with `frontend/lib/criteria.mjs` by construction.

- `simple-doc.json` — built by `buildCriteriaDocument()` (Simple mode),
  canonicalized by `parseAndValidateCriteria()`. Synthetic.
- `advanced-doc.json` — hand-written custom criteria (checks, files,
  labels, reviews, issue, author association), canonicalized by
  `parseAndValidateCriteria()`. Synthetic.
- `simple-tx.json`, `advanced-tx.json` — NEAR RPC `tx`-response-shaped
  envelopes wrapping the canonical docs above. Synthetic hashes/signers.
- `failed-tx.json` — a FAILED `create_bounty` attempt for bounty 9001
  carrying different criteria. The resolver must skip it. Synthetic.
- `receipts-page1.json`, `receipts-page2.json` — NearBlocks v1
  account-transactions-shaped pages: noise (transfers, other methods,
  other contracts), the failed attempt, both creations, and a duplicate
  receipt. Synthetic.
- `valen-414201122891942-doc.json` — the REAL canonical criteria
  document of bounty 414201122891942, byte-extracted from its on-chain
  `create_bounty` transaction arguments. Public chain data, no secrets.
- `valen-414201122891942-tx.json` — the REAL NEAR RPC `tx` response for
  `HFMhbrJ9BbPabEQWKDrqduqVkPxVxKyhwo2gCKgMu9qx`
  (signer `diaryofdero.testnet`), trimmed to `result.status` +
  `result.transaction`. Public chain data.
- `valen-414201122891942-receipts.json` — receipts page containing the
  REAL creation transaction hash/signer plus synthetic noise.
- `meta.json` — bounty ids, hashes, tx hashes, signers (machine-readable).

The valen fixtures are public on-chain history used as one regression
case among several: the resolver under test contains no
bounty-specific logic, and the test asserts identical behavior across
all three fixtures.
